meaning: Implementation plan for six collections in the existing Library; not a runtime whitelist or execution record.

collections.title: Verified commercial and industrial tariff records
collections.first_deliverable: One complete supported US customer-class bill and independently reproduced source worksheet.
collections.remaining_gate: One current eligible schedule, effective sheets and complete applicable rider set; intended-use rights; full supported billing rules.

collections.title: Historical wholesale price series
collections.first_deliverable: One cleared CAISO DAM product/node/day with source calendar, revision and component identity.
collections.remaining_gate: Exact source terms and numerical settlement oracle; expansion requires operator-specific product/time handling.

collections.title: Historical PPA benchmark references
collections.first_deliverable: A small attributable executed-solar benchmark reference selection, visibly separate from signed contracts.
collections.remaining_gate: Selected-sheet rights, economic basis and supported apply semantics; wind and vendor indices not blanket cleared.

collections.title: Reported wholesale contracts and transactions
collections.first_deliverable: One current EQR quarter/product/unit, with traceable join keys and revisions.
collections.remaining_gate: Actual current quarter/specification, Order917 reconciliation and independent record/aggregate oracle.

collections.title: Regional financial reference series
collections.first_deliverable: One dated CAD-per-USD reference; apply only after explicit currency-path verification.
collections.remaining_gate: Numerical CPI/rate/Mexico samples still require validation; FX direction, date policy, basis and full valuation/export path.

collections.title: Additional technology and operating-cost references
collections.first_deliverable: One scoped cost/O&M reference with cost boundaries; reuse existing regional overlays.
collections.remaining_gate: New rows need evidence matching technology/capacity basis/currency; no invented battery split, failure law or private quotation.
